title.narrative: Building Capacities of Civil Society Organizations, Local Government Units, and Government Line Agencies in Mindanao to Address Child Labor Through Promotion of Acceptable Conditions of Work in Crop Agriculture.

description.narrative: The action will contribute to efforts to combat worst forms of child labor in Davao del Norte, Bukidnon and Northern Cotabato provinces by improving the capacity of and bringing together civil society organisations, local government units and government line agencies to better undertsand and play theirrole in addressing child labor and promoting acceptable working conditions.
